name: Integrated WTI Forecast
point_meaning: Price median; arithmetic convex combination of member price forecasts including RW, preserved by risk calibration.

fixed_path_metrics.interpretation: 17 correlated targets from one origin; descriptive evaluation only

module_roles.m2: Selected monthly STL contributes at horizons 13,14,15,16,20.
module_roles.lstm: Three-seed sequence forecasts contribute to horizons 1–20.
module_roles.ml_point: Elastic Net enters selection and ablation; final direct weights are zero.
module_roles.ml_distribution: Historically selected ML conditional quantiles provide risk distributions at horizons 1–20.
module_roles.rw: Explicit price fallback, selected alone at horizon 60.

limitations: Base specifications use the full historical development window. Meta forecasts are coefficient-cross-fitted conditional on these specifications, not a fully nested unbiased historical test.
Retrospective held-out evaluation; October was inspected in prior module work. No October observations or scores select fusion parameters.
Original train/test are development data; outer meta-checks do not remove full-window base-specification selection.
ML direct-point weights are zero. Inclusion in the selection system is not evidence of positive forecast contribution.
October daily forecasts improve but the single fixed path remains 16.4% worse than RW; only 17/13 daily outcomes.
Historical risk forward check is weaker at 60 days; interval coverage is not guaranteed.
